description: BSR Task Library — 可安装的 Agent Skills 注册表

install.bsr_cli: bsr skills install <slug>  (见 bsr skills 子命令)

skills.goal: 按楼层编号规则重命名所有 IfcSpace
skills.constraint: Space names must be unique per storey
skills.source: buildingSMART MSG example; common BIM mandate

skills.goal: 统一 IfcWall 的 IfcWallType 关联
skills.input: IFC with walls having no type assignment
skills.output: IFC with each wall linked to a IfcWallType
skills.constraint: All IfcWall must have IfcRelDefinesByType
skills.source: IfcOpenShell code examples; BIMTester common rules

skills.goal: 为所有 IfcWall 添加 Pset_WallCommon.FireRating
skills.input: IFC with walls missing fire rating
skills.output: IFC with FireRating property on all walls
skills.constraint: FireRating must be one of: 0.5HR, 1HR, 2HR, 4HR
skills.source: buildingSMART IFC4 property sets; fire code compliance

skills.goal: 检测并修复未关联 IfcBuildingStorey 的 IfcSlab
skills.input: IFC with slabs not contained in any storey
skills.output: IFC with all slabs in IfcRelContainedInSpatialStructure
skills.constraint: Each IfcSlab must have exactly one container
skills.source: BIMTester spatial containment rules; real IFC export issues

skills.goal: 按楼层统计 IfcSpace 数量并输出表格
skills.output: CSV table with floor name, space count, area sum
skills.constraint: N/A — read-only query
skills.source: Open IFC Model Repository analysis; quantity surveying

skills.goal: 生成房间装修做法明细表
skills.input: IFC with IfcSpace having finish properties
skills.output: CSV schedule with floor/wall/ceiling finish per room
skills.constraint: Rooms without finish properties flagged as warning
skills.source: COBie requirements; facility management handover

skills.goal: 按关联房间名自动命名 IfcDoor
skills.constraint: Door name must include room name prefix
skills.source: BIM mandate naming conventions; common handover requirement

skills.goal: 检查所有 IfcDoor 宽度是否满足最小值
skills.constraint: Door width >= 800mm (office), >= 600mm (residential)
skills.source: building code compliance; accessibility requirements

skills.goal: 将房间按部门分组为 IfcZone
skills.input: IFC with IfcSpace but no IfcZone
skills.constraint: Each zone must reference existing spaces
skills.source: buildingSMART zone example; facility management

skills.goal: 提取所有 MEP 设备参数表
skills.output: CSV schedule with flow rates, pressure, power
skills.constraint: N/A — read-only
skills.source: RWTH E3D DigitalHub HVAC dataset; MEP handover

skills.goal: 检测空间边界重叠
skills.constraint: Space boundaries must not intersect
skills.source: Solibri model checking; common IFC export defect

skills.goal: 按医技科室分类 IfcSpace 并添加属性
skills.output: IFC with spaces classified as OR/ICU/ward/lab/pharmacy
skills.constraint: Classification must match predefined hospital room types
skills.source: HITOS hospital IFC model; healthcare BIM standards

skills.goal: 检查医疗气体管道分区
skills.input: IFC with IfcFlowSegment for medical gas
skills.constraint: Medical gas pipes must be zone-isolated
skills.source: Hospital MEP validation; NFPA 99 compliance

skills.goal: 将教学楼 IfcSpace 按'楼号-楼层-编号'规则重命名
skills.constraint: Name must match regex: ^[A-Z]-\d+-\d{2}$
skills.source: buildingSMART school example; education BIM mandate

skills.goal: 验证教室面积是否满足学生容量要求
skills.constraint: Area per student >= 1.8m²
skills.source: School design code compliance

skills.goal: 按防火分区为 IfcSpace 添加 FireRisk 属性
skills.constraint: Fire zones must be contiguous
skills.source: Industrial fire code; IFC property sets

skills.goal: 检查吊车净空高度
skills.input: IFC with industrial building and crane
skills.output: Report checking crane vs structure clearance
skills.constraint: Crane clearance >= 500mm
skills.source: Industrial BIM validation; KIT IFC examples

skills.goal: 统一桥梁构件命名
skills.input: IFC with bridge elements named generically
skills.constraint: Name must include structural role
skills.source: KIT bridge examples; planen-bauen 4.0 bridge IFC

skills.goal: 为 IfcBeam/IfcPile 添加材质属性
skills.output: IFC with material on all structural elements
skills.constraint: Each structural element must have IfcMaterial
skills.source: buildingSMART IFC4X3 bridge extension; material passport

skills.goal: 检测门窗开口未正确关联 IfcOpeningElement 的缺陷
skills.input: IFC with doors/windows but no opening elements
skills.constraint: Each IfcDoor/IfcWindow must have a corresponding IfcOpeningElement
skills.source: BIMTester rule; common Revit IFC export issue

skills.goal: 统一属性集命名（消除拼写差异）
skills.constraint: Property set names must match IFC4 schema
skills.source: buildingSMART validation service errors; xbim issues

skills.goal: 修复重复 GUID（已有 BSR task）
skills.constraint: GlobalId must be unique across file
skills.source: IfcOpenShell validation; buildingSMART IDs spec

skills.goal: 将 IFC 构件数量/类型/属性导出为 CSV
skills.output: CSV file with element count, type, property summary
skills.constraint: N/A — export only
skills.source: IfcCSV tool; common quantity surveyor request

skills.goal: 运行 ifcopenshell.validate 语法检查
skills.constraint: Schema compliance: IFC4 or IFC2X3
skills.source: buildingSMART validation service; IfcOpenShell validate module

skills.goal: 为所有 IfcWall/IfcSlab 添加标准化 Pset_WallCommon.FireRating
skills.output: IFC with FireRating on all fire-rated elements
skills.constraint: FireRating must be 0.5HR/1HR/2HR/4HR
skills.source: IfcOpenShell api.pset example; buildingSMART IFC4 property sets

skills.goal: 为所有 IfcDoor 添加 Pset_DoorCommon.FireRating
skills.output: IFC with FireRating on all doors
skills.constraint: Each door in fire zone must have rating
skills.source: buildingSMART Pset_DoorCommon; fire code compliance

skills.goal: 为 IfcWall 添加标准面积/体积/长度量
skills.input: IFC walls without quantity take-off data
skills.constraint: Quantities must have valid measure values
skills.source: IfcOpenShell api.pset.add_qto; QTO standard

skills.goal: 为 IfcSlab 添加标准量
skills.constraint: NetArea/NetVolume/Perimeter required
skills.source: IfcOpenShell qto example; quantity surveying

skills.goal: 将 IfcType 的属性复制到所有实例
skills.input: IFC with properties only on type, not instances
skills.output: IFC where each instance inherits type properties
skills.constraint: Instance properties must not conflict with type
skills.source: xbim issue: type properties not exporting to IFC; Revit export workaround

skills.goal: 验证所有 IfcBuildingElement 有且仅有一个空间容器
skills.input: IFC with elements missing spatial containment
skills.constraint: Each element must be in exactly one IfcBuildingStorey
skills.source: buildingSMART SPS007; validation service gherkin rules

skills.goal: 验证所有必填属性（IFC schema WHERE rules）
skills.constraint: All mandatory schema attributes must be populated
skills.source: buildingSMART validation: schema compliance; normative checks

skills.goal: 验证没有实例化抽象实体
skills.constraint: No abstract IfcObject classes must be instantiated
skills.source: buildingSMART validation service; EXPRESS schema rules

skills.goal: 统一设置所有实体的 IfcOwnerHistory
skills.constraint: All entities must have populated OwnerHistory
skills.source: buildingSMART ownership compliance; implementer agreements

skills.goal: 验证所有 IfcSpace 有非空唯一名称
skills.input: IFC with unnamed or duplicate spaces
skills.constraint: Each space must have unique non-empty name
skills.source: buildingSMART industry practices; IDS requirements

skills.goal: 验证所有 IfcBuildingElement 有名称
skills.constraint: Each element should have descriptive name
skills.source: buildingSMART common practice checks; BIMTester

skills.goal: 验证元素是否有 IfcClassification 关联
skills.constraint: Each element should have at least one classification
skills.source: buildingSMART bSDD compliance; classification standards

skills.goal: 将空 Property 值填充为默认值 N/A
skills.output: IFC with all property values non-empty
skills.constraint: Empty properties should be set to N/A or —
skills.source: Revit IFC export: empty properties skipped (Issue #160); xbim workaround

skills.goal: 检测并修复悬空的关系引用
skills.input: IFC with relationships pointing to deleted entities
skills.constraint: All IfcRel* must reference existing entities
skills.source: xbim common issues; buildingSMART reference integrity

skills.goal: 将 IFC2X3 模型迁移到 IFC4 schema
skills.constraint: All entities mapped to IFC4 equivalents
skills.source: buildingSMART migration; IfcOpenShell schema conversion

skills.goal: 如果不存在，创建 IfcBuildingStorey 层级
skills.constraint: Project → Site → Building → Storey structure
skills.source: IfcOpenHouse tutorial; BIM spatial hierarchy requirement

skills.goal: 将游离元素分配到合适的楼层
skills.input: IFC with orphans not in any storey
skills.output: IFC with all elements in a storey
skills.constraint: Each element assigned to closest storey by Z
skills.source: IfcOpenShell spatial.assign_container; common BIM issue

skills.goal: 创建完整的 IFC 项目骨架（Project→Site→Building→Storey）
skills.constraint: Must have IfcProject, IfcSite, IfcBuilding, at least 1 IfcBuildingStorey
skills.source: IfcOpenHouse generate house tutorial; buildingSMART PCERT

skills.goal: 验证 IfcFlowSegment 连接性
skills.constraint: Each duct must be connected to at least 2 fittings or terminals
skills.source: RWTH DigitalHub HVAC; MEP validation

skills.goal: 将 MEP 设备分配到 IfcSystem
skills.output: IFC with each MEP element in a system
skills.constraint: Each flow element should be in IfcDistributionSystem
skills.source: buildingSMART IFC4 MEP; system assignment

skills.goal: 根据 IDS (Information Delivery Specification) 文件验证 IFC
skills.constraint: All IDS requirements must pass
skills.source: buildingSMART IDS; IfcTester validation; BIMTester rules

skills.goal: 验证所有物理元素有材质
skills.constraint: Each physical element should have IfcMaterial
skills.source: BIMTester common rules; material passport

skills.goal: 导出 IFC 实体树（父子关系嵌套层级）
skills.output: JSON tree of spatial containment hierarchy
skills.constraint: N/A — export only
skills.source: IfcOpenShell traverse() example; entity tree visualization

skills.goal: 验证 IfcRel 的反向属性完整性
skills.constraint: All IfcRelationship must have valid inverses
skills.source: IfcOpenShell schema querying; inverse attribute validation

skills.goal: 提取 IfcSpace 的 IfcRelSpaceBoundary 拓扑关系
skills.output: JSON listing each room's bounding walls/doors/windows
skills.constraint: N/A — read-only
skills.source: buildingSMART space boundary example; HITOS model analysis

skills.goal: 验证梁柱节点连接
skills.constraint: Each beam end must connect to a column or wall
skills.source: KIT structural IFC examples; structural validation
